name: WorldBorder
author: Brettflan
description: Efficient, feature-rich plugin for limiting the size of your worlds.

permissions.name: worldborder.*
permissions.description: Grants all WorldBorder permissions

permissions.name: worldborder.bypass
permissions.description: Can enable bypass mode to go beyond the border

permissions.name: worldborder.bypasslist
permissions.description: Can get list of players with border bypass enabled

permissions.name: worldborder.clear
permissions.description: Can remove any border

permissions.name: worldborder.debug
permissions.description: Can enable/disable debug output to console

permissions.name: worldborder.delay
permissions.description: Can set the frequency at which the plugin checks for border crossings

permissions.name: worldborder.denypearl
permissions.description: Can enable/disable direct cancellation of ender pearls thrown past border

permissions.name: worldborder.dynmap
permissions.description: Can enable/disable DynMap border display integration

permissions.name: worldborder.dynmapmsg
permissions.description: Can set the label text for borders shown in DynMap

permissions.name: worldborder.fill
permissions.description: Can fill in (generate) any missing map chunks out to the border

permissions.name: worldborder.fillautosave
permissions.description: Can set the world save interval for the Fill process

permissions.name: worldborder.getmsg
permissions.description: Can view the border crossing message

permissions.name: worldborder.help
permissions.description: Can view the command reference help pages

permissions.name: worldborder.knockback
permissions.description: Can set the knockback distance for border crossings

permissions.name: worldborder.list
permissions.description: Can view a list of all borders

permissions.name: worldborder.portal
permissions.description: Can enable/disable portal redirection to be inside border

permissions.name: worldborder.radius
permissions.description: Can set the radius of an existing border

permissions.name: worldborder.reload
permissions.description: Can force the plugin to reload from the config file

permissions.name: worldborder.remount
permissions.description: Can set the delay before remounting a player to their vehicle after knockback

permissions.name: worldborder.set
permissions.description: Can set borders for any world

permissions.name: worldborder.setmsg
permissions.description: Can set the border crossing message

permissions.name: worldborder.shape
permissions.description: Can set the default shape (round or square) for all borders

permissions.name: worldborder.trim
permissions.description: Can trim (remove) any excess map chunks outside of the border

permissions.name: worldborder.whoosh
permissions.description: Can enable/disable "whoosh" knockback effect

permissions.name: worldborder.wrap
permissions.description: Can set border crossings to wrap around to the other side of the world

permissions.name: worldborder.wshape
permissions.description: Can set an overriding border shape for a single world

source.original_relative_path: 流星插件包/PC基础插件/[边界]WorldBorder.jar
